title: [AMD] Restore DeepSeek-V4 DSpark token acceptance
body_opening:
## What broke

PR #34597 (`34206c00175a`) introduced this regression. Its goal was to speed up MTP/EAGLE by moving target verification from the prefill route to the decode route.

The new check asked only whether a request was in the shared `TARGET_VERIFY` phase. DSpark uses that same phase name for both its target and draft workers, so both DSpark workers were moved to the MTP/EAGLE route by accident.

title: Convert IPC dataclasses to msgspec.Struct with opt-in msgpack transport

## Motivation

Prepare SGLang IPC payloads for typed msgpack serialization without changing the default runtime transport yet.

This PR converts the IPC request/output classes from dataclasses to `msgspec.Struct`, but keeps pickle IPC enabled by default for compatibility. Developers can opt into the msgspec/msgpack transport by setting:

```bash
SGLANG_USE_PICKLE_IPC=0
```

For auditing fallback behavior, set:

```bash
SGLANG_LOG_PICKLE_IPC_OBJECTS=1
```

- Convert IPC base/request/output classes in `io_struct.py` from dataclasses to `msgspec.Struct`.
- Add pydantic schema support for msgspec-backed request structs.
